help.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to know to shop with confidence at Tech & Electronic.
help.howToShop: How to Shop — Step by Step
help.howToShopSubtitle: Follow these steps to go from browsing to doorstep delivery.
help.step1Desc: Click Register at the top of the page. Enter your name, email, and password. Verify your account and you're ready to shop.
help.step1D1: Go to the top navigation and click Login → Register.
help.step1D2: Fill in your full name, email address, and a secure password.
help.step1D3: Click the Register button — you'll be logged in immediately.
help.step1D4: Visit My Profile to add your shipping address and phone number.
help.step2Desc: Use the search bar or browse by category to find the electronics you need.
help.step2D1: Use the search bar at the top to search by product name or keyword.
help.step2D2: Click Categories in the navbar to filter by product type.
help.step2D3: Click on any product card to see full details, images, and reviews.
help.step2D4: Check stock availability and product specifications on the detail page.
help.step3Desc: Add items to your cart to buy now, or save them to your wishlist for later.
help.step3D1: On a product page, choose your quantity and click Add to Cart.
help.step3D2: Click the heart icon to save a product to your Wishlist.
help.step3D3: Access your Cart or Wishlist from the navigation bar at any time.
help.step3D4: Adjust quantities or remove items directly from the Cart page.
help.step4Desc: Enter your delivery details and choose between online payment or cash on delivery.
help.step4D1: Click Checkout from your Cart page.
help.step4D2: Enter your shipping address and phone number.
help.step4D3: Choose your payment method: Chapa, CBE Birr, Telebirr, or Cash on Delivery.
help.step4D4: Click Place Order — you'll receive an email confirmation.
help.step5Desc: Monitor your order status in real time from your My Orders page.
help.step5D1: Go to My Orders from the navigation bar.
help.step5D2: Each order shows its current status: Pending, Processing, Shipped, or Delivered.
help.step5D3: Your order ID is shown for reference if you need to contact support.
help.step5D4: Once delivered, you can leave a review on the product page.
help.step6Desc: Share your experience by rating and reviewing products you've purchased.
help.step6D1: Navigate to the product page of an item you purchased.
help.step6D2: Scroll down to the Reviews section.
help.step6D3: Choose a star rating (1–5) and write your feedback.
help.step6D4: Click Submit Review — your review helps other shoppers.
help.supportReply24h: Our support team is here for you. Reach out and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

faq.q1: How do I place an order?
faq.a1: Browse products, add items to your cart, go to Checkout, fill in your delivery details, choose a payment method, and confirm your order. You will receive an email confirmation.
faq.q2: Can I cancel or modify my order?
faq.a2: Orders can be cancelled or modified while in Pending status. Go to My Orders and contact us immediately via the Contact page or email shelemaagari@gmail.com.
faq.q3: How do I track my order?
faq.a3: Log in and go to My Orders. Each order shows its current status: Pending, Processing, Shipped, or Delivered.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: We accept Chapa, CBE Birr, Telebirr, Awash Bank, Bank of Abyssinia, and Cash on Delivery for eligible locations.
faq.a5: Yes. All online payments are processed by Chapa over HTTPS with bank-level encryption. We never store your card details.
faq.a6: For online payments, you are charged immediately upon placing the order. For Cash on Delivery, payment is collected upon delivery.
faq.a7: Standard delivery within Addis Ababa takes 1–3 business days. Other regions take 3–7 business days.
faq.a8: Yes! Free shipping on all orders over ETB 5,000. Standard shipping fees apply to smaller orders.
faq.a9: You can return defective or incorrect items within 7 days of delivery. Contact us with your order number and photos of the item.
faq.a10: Approved refunds are processed within 5–10 business days to the original payment method.
faq.q11: How do I reset my password?
faq.a11: Click Login → 'Forgot Password?'. Enter your registered email and we'll send a reset link within a few minutes.
faq.q12: How do I update my profile or address?
faq.a12: Go to Account → Profile from the navigation bar to update your name, phone, address, and profile photo.
faq.q13: How do I contact customer support?
faq.a13: Use our Contact page, email shelemaagari@gmail.com, or call +251 974 007 772. We respond within 24 hours.

shippingPolicy.subtitle: Everything you need to know about delivery.
shippingPolicy.areasDesc: We currently deliver to all areas within Addis Ababa and selected regions across Ethiopia. During checkout, you will be asked to provide your delivery address — please ensure it is accurate to avoid delays.
shippingPolicy.timesL1: Addis Ababa: 1–3 business days after order confirmation.
shippingPolicy.timesL2: Other regions: 3–7 business days depending on location.
shippingPolicy.timesL3: Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed the next business day.
shippingPolicy.feesL1: Free Shipping on all orders over ETB 5,000.
shippingPolicy.feesL2: Orders below ETB 5,000 incur a flat shipping fee calculated at checkout.
shippingPolicy.feesL3: Remote areas may incur additional delivery charges.
shippingPolicy.trackingDesc: Once your order is shipped, you can track its status from My Orders page. Status updates include: Pending → Processing → Shipped → Delivered.
shippingPolicy.damagedDesc: If your order arrives damaged or is lost in transit, please contact us within 48 hours at shelemaagari@gmail.com with your order number and photos. We will arrange a replacement or refund promptly.
shippingPolicy.contactDesc: For shipping inquiries: shelemaagari@gmail.com or call +251 974 007 772.

returnsPolicy.subtitle: Our hassle-free return and refund policy.
returnsPolicy.eligibilityDesc: Items may be returned within 7 days of delivery if they meet the following conditions:
returnsPolicy.eligibilityL1: The item is defective, damaged, or significantly different from its description.
returnsPolicy.eligibilityL2: The item is unused and in its original packaging.
returnsPolicy.eligibilityL3: All original accessories, manuals, and tags are included.
returnsPolicy.eligibilityExcl: Items that cannot be returned include: software, downloadable products, and items marked as final sale.
returnsPolicy.howL1: Email shelemaagari@gmail.com with your order number and a brief description of the issue.
returnsPolicy.howL2: Attach clear photos of the item showing the defect or damage.
returnsPolicy.howL3: Our team will respond within 24 hours with return instructions.
returnsPolicy.howL4: Once we receive and inspect the item, we will process your refund.
returnsPolicy.refundL1: Approved refunds are processed within 5–10 business days.
returnsPolicy.refundL2: Refunds are issued to the original payment method.
returnsPolicy.refundL3: Chapa payments are refunded to your Chapa wallet or card.
returnsPolicy.refundL4: Cash on Delivery refunds are issued via bank transfer or mobile money.
returnsPolicy.exchangeDesc: We offer exchanges for defective or incorrect items. If you prefer an exchange over a refund, let us know when you contact us and we will arrange it subject to stock availability.

termsPolicy.s2L2: Transmit any unsolicited or unauthorized advertising material.

termsPolicy.s6Desc: All content on the Site — text, graphics, logos, images, and software — is the property of Tech & Electronic or its content suppliers and is protected by applicable copyright and trademark laws.
termsPolicy.s7Desc: Tech & Electronic shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use this Site or products purchased through it.
termsPolicy.s8Desc: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Continued use of the Site after any changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
termsPolicy.s9Desc: If you have any questions regarding these Terms, contact us at shelemaagari@gmail.com or call +251 974 007 772.

privacyPolicy.s1Desc: Tech & Electronic ('we', 'us', 'our') respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our website.
privacyPolicy.s2Desc: We may collect the following information:
privacyPolicy.s2L1: Account data: Name, email address, password (hashed).
privacyPolicy.s2L2: Order data: Shipping address, phone number, order history.
privacyPolicy.s2L3: Payment data: Transaction reference numbers (we do not store full card details).
privacyPolicy.s2L4: Usage data: Pages visited, search queries, browser type, IP address.
privacyPolicy.s2L5: Communications: Messages you send through our Contact form.
privacyPolicy.s3L1: To process and fulfill your orders.
privacyPolicy.s3L2: To send order confirmations and shipping updates.
privacyPolicy.s3L3: To respond to your inquiries and support requests.
privacyPolicy.s3L4: To improve our website, products, and services.
privacyPolicy.s3L5: To detect and prevent fraudulent transactions.
privacyPolicy.s3L6: To send occasional promotional emails (you may opt out at any time).
privacyPolicy.s4Desc: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We may share data with:
privacyPolicy.s4L1: Payment processors (Chapa) to handle transactions securely.
privacyPolicy.s4L3: Cloud service providers (e.g., Cloudinary for image hosting) under strict data agreements.
privacyPolicy.s5Desc: We implement industry-standard technical measures, including HTTPS encryption and secure password hashing, to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.
privacyPolicy.s6Desc: You have the right to access, update, or request deletion of your personal information at any time through your Profile page or by contacting us.
privacyPolicy.s7Desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at shelemaagari@gmail.com or call +251 974 007 772.

about.heroSub: We make advanced technology accessible to everyone — bringing the world's best gadgets, laptops, smartphones, and accessories directly to your doorstep.
about.v1Desc: We carry the newest products with cutting-edge features and top performance, updated every season.
about.v2Desc: Reliable delivery across Ethiopia. Addis Ababa orders arrive within 1–3 days; nationwide 3–7 days.
about.v3Desc: Multiple verified payment options — Chapa, Telebirr, CBE Birr, BOA, Awash Bank and Cash on Delivery.
about.v4Desc: Our team is available around the clock to answer questions, resolve issues, and ensure satisfaction.
about.v5Desc: Not satisfied? Return within 30 days. We make the process simple and hassle-free.
about.v6Desc: Every item we sell is sourced directly from verified manufacturers and authorized distributors.
about.storyP1: Founded in Addis Ababa, Tech & Electronic was created to bridge the gap between world-class technology and Ethiopian customers. We believe that access to high-quality electronics shouldn't be complicated or expensive.
about.storyP2: From individual consumers shopping for their first laptop to tech enthusiasts and growing businesses needing reliable hardware, we provide carefully curated, 100% genuine products backed by local warranties and responsive customer support.
about.missionDesc: To deliver genuine, premium electronics at fair prices with fast delivery, localized payment options, and exceptional service to every corner of Ethiopia.
about.visionDesc: To become Ethiopia's most trusted and customer-centric e-commerce destination for consumer electronics and digital technology.
